title: The no-search-results state renders with a distinct visual and a clear-filters recovery control
asA: operator running a search or filter that yields zero rows
iWant: the no-search-results state to render with a distinct visual and a clear-filters recovery control
soThat: I distinguish this state from empty-list and my next action is to widen the query, not to create a row

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a search or filter yielding zero rows, the no-search-results state renders inside role="region" with a data-visual="no-search-results" wrapper distinct from empty-list, echoing the query terms verbatim inside a data-query wrapper, and a keyboard-reachable [data-recovery="clear-filters"] control that removes the search parameters on click. The pack drives /probe/search?q=needle, reads the region, the wrapper attribute, the echoed query and the recovery control.

The surface echoes the exact search query verbatim in the DOM (data-query attribute or visible text) so a screen reader can name the searched term; a query containing special characters is escaped for HTML but never truncated.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a no-search-results state on the query "foo & bar"
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries the query verbatim (HTML-escaped) and no truncation occurs

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the clear-filters recovery is fired and the underlying reload fails, the surface stays on the no-search-results state and the polite live region announces the failure; no false clear-success is emitted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a no-search-results state and a failing clear-filters reload
acceptanceCriteria.then: the surface stays on no-search-results, the polite live region announces the failure and no clear-success is announced
